method.demand: r=D*dL_per_patch/dF0; derivative with respect to the fixed context coefficient u in F0+u*D
method.direction_details: Original four16-channel branch responses and original1x1 weights; actual uniform3-class p=1/3; FP32 direction
method.operating_point: F0 unchanged; original frozen model and attribute heads; no network or model-parameter update
method.comparison: Only the measured context direction changes relative to the prior SAAM gain diagnostic; attributes, fixed FIT moments, patch bank and loss stay fixed
method.loss: Original Dice+BCE over the full padded128-cubed patch
method.attributes: A is boundary-measurement applicability, not vessel presence or a veto; B is boundary rank ambiguity
method.zA: Fixed normalized CT-predicted A times fixed FIT24 B prior
method.zAB: Fixed normalized CT-predicted A times CT-predicted B
method.fitting: Unregularized FP64 OLS on FIT24 case-equal/16-patch-equal spatial-mean moments;64 channels separately and at most3 fixed axes

units.moments: Spatial means retain64 separate channels; readout energies and dots also average channels
units.context_budget: Context-coefficient field divided by one common FIT24 spatial-and-channel RMS
units.first_variation: -M*64*mean_channel_spatial(r*delta)/FIT_delta_RMS; per-patch derivative already restored, no further factor2
units.derivative: The original B2 loss averages per-sample losses; measurement restores each patch derivative at the fixed SAAM forward, not the original Adam trajectory

sign: r=D*d(per-patch loss)/dF0; positive r·delta means context-coefficient step -delta has negative first-order loss variation

separable_minus_A_only.normalization: One common FIT24 delta RMS; no probe or case-specific fitting

separable_minus_constant.normalization: One common FIT24 delta RMS; no probe or case-specific fitting

primary_dual_direction_check.rule: Both increments require12 supported, mean>0, at least8 positive and all3 source means>0

limitations: This is one fixed context-coefficient tangent at unchanged F0, not F0 multiplicative gain or general receptive-field mixing.
The four original branch responses have different receptive fields; they are not established anatomical experts.
A positive first-order loss signal is not achieved loss, Dice, clDice, clinical benefit or GTA efficacy.
Both increment direction checks are required; passing only supports the prelocked epsilon0.001 finite-step assessment and never authorizes training.
Prior failed gain-route experiments remain stopped and cannot be rescued by changing the operator basis.
Absolute demand energy or descent magnitude across different layers or bases cannot rank architectures or operator sites.
Previously trained frozen features and reused TRAIN patches prevent claims of blind validation or zero-shot generalization.
All16 slots, including empty/unknown, and all actual feature sites including padding remain included; overlapping patches are not independent cases.
Zero norms or deficient ranks remain undefined, never imputed zero; no feature, threshold, ridge or support search.
Ordinary gradient energy and context-demand energy have different denominators; exact-zero-D energy shares are descriptive only.
